newsitem.title: USA: Sharon Real Estate buys two firms.
newsitem.headline: Sharon Real Estate buys two firms.

text.p: Sharon Real Estate Consultants Inc announced Monday that it purchased Beverage Source International Inc (BSI) of Del Mar, Calif., in exchange for 925,000 restricted common shares.
In light of the BSI acquisition Sharon said it has ended negotiations to buy ProTeam International Inc of San Diego, Calif.
Separately, Sharon said it acquired Rayco Construction Co of Conroe, Texas for 500,000 restricted common shares.
Both BSI and Rayco will become wholly owned subsidiaries of Sharon.
BSI was recently founded by Mark Darnell and John Jarvis, who brought to market the Spalding sports drink.
Rayco is an approved contractor for the State of Texas.
Sharon Real Estate Consultants is a developmental stage company seeking various acquisition opportunities.
